correctness.evidence: The degree-two derivative images give rank 9 and Hessian at all ones is −363, but a single algebraically independent p0=UVW and nonzero Hessian violate Perazzo Definition 2.7 (arXiv:2402.09188); the advertised classification/open-setting premise is false.

originality.evidence: Its claimed novel placement in the unsettled ternary-base Perazzo/Jordan regime is invalid; remaining explicit apolar and Jordan calculations use established mixed-Hessian machinery (arXiv:1811.02072).

scientific_value.evidence: An isolated non-Perazzo example remains computationally illustrative, but does not advance the advertised Perazzo problem; no separately consequential theorem is established.

limitations: Other exact numerical claims were not exhaustively independently replayed; this disposition rests on the decisive definition mismatch and Hessian witness.
